title: change GMTLS to TLCP
description:
GMTLS is a non-official name, now that these is a Chinese National Standard called   
"GB/T 38636-2020 Information security technology—Transport layer cryptography protocol（TLCP）"   
so we replace GMTLS by TLCP

notes.body:
now that there is only one TLCP version number(just 0x0101, no 0x0102),so we don't need to use TLCPv1 or TLCPv1.1 as name.
we could change name to TLCPv1.1 after another TLCP version(like 0x0102) defined(this my took a long time).

changes_data.diff:
@@ -251,7 +251,7 @@ typedef struct _StringInfo {
                                           http://www-archive.mozilla.org/projects/security/pki/nss/ssl/draft02.html */
 #define SSLV3_VERSION          0x300
 #define TLSV1_VERSION          0x301
-#define GMTLSV1_VERSION        0x101
+#define TLCPV1_VERSION         0x101
 #define TLSV1DOT1_VERSION      0x302
 #define TLSV1DOT2_VERSION      0x303
 #define TLSV1DOT3_VERSION      0x304
